interface.longDescription:
Version 0.5.1. Operator is the Codex plugin for Agent Operator Kit: a human-supervised cockpit for real projects, including V5.1 feature-scoped dependency graphs and a capacity-bounded runnable frontier. On the first Operator prompt it runs a read-only project preflight and recommends the correct setup, repair, migration, or continuation path.

Use it to coordinate feature chats, isolated worktrees, reusable lane roles, task packets, handoffs, memory, roadmap items, feedback intake, planning, design review, UX audits, journeys, and incubation. V5.1 requires no signing authority, Keychain credentials, proof broker, trusted host, lease, or heartbeat loop.
